note: Mega Phase A (PRs A1-A4): transforms MEMBRANE from a command-oriented local inference runtime into a persistent local AI backend an OpenAI-compatible application can talk to, without ever building a second runtime/planner implementation. Every REAL row is a genuine local invocation on this dev host (CPU-only build -- no GPU backend compiled into build-llama-final/build-llama-asan; the runtime-session/planner code paths are backend-agnostic and were already validated on real Vulkan hardware in earlier phases, see results/context-recommendation/cli-validation.json). SYNTHETIC rows are ctest-registered unit/integration tests with no real GGUF model dependency (CI-safe). SOURCE_ANALYSIS rows are direct code-reading confirmations, not runs.

context_auto_in_server.label: REAL
context_auto_in_server.note: A client never specifies ctx/gpu_layers/kv_precision/kv_placement -- the server internally runs the same context-recommendation + host-memory-guard + joint-planner pipeline --ctx auto uses (membrane_resolve_ctx_auto(), PR A1), using the request that triggers a model's first load as the real prompt input.
context_auto_in_server.disclosed_limitation: GPU layers/KV precision are fixed once, at first load, from whichever request triggered it -- they cannot replan without a model switch. A much larger subsequent request to an already-loaded model is not replanned. Documented in docs/server.md, not hidden.

security_scope.label: SOURCE_ANALYSIS
facts: Default bind is 127.0.0.1 -- confirmed in server.cpp's own option defaults and membrane_server_run()'s explicit refusal of any other bind address without --allow-non-loopback.
No authentication anywhere in the request path (confirmed: no Authorization-header check exists in server.cpp) -- only defensible for loopback-only binding, documented as such.
No telemetry, no outbound network call anywhere in tools/membrane/server.cpp (confirmed: the only network I/O is the httplib::Server's own inbound listener).

HTTP-facing error text is built independently in server.cpp (send_json_error()), never forwarding membrane_run_error_t's terminal-oriented text (which can include a real absolute path) verbatim -- confirmed by test_server's own filesystem-path-leak assertion on the MODEL_NOT_FOUND error.

model_cache_policy.label: REAL
model_cache_policy.policy: one active model at a time
model_cache_policy.evidence: See http_server.evidence above (model reuse and model switch rows) -- both directly measured, not assumed from the code alone.

streaming_decision.label: SOURCE_ANALYSIS
streaming_decision.decision: DEFERRED (reevaluated at PR A4 per Section 36 of the task, not carried over unexamined)
streaming_decision.reason: membrane_session_generate()'s token callback is push-based (the decode loop calls back per-token, synchronously, on the request's own thread); cpp-httplib's chunked content provider is pull-based (httplib calls back to ask for the next chunk). Bridging the two safely requires a background generation thread plus a synchronized queue and a real client-disconnect/cancellation story -- a genuine architecture change, not a small addition. stream=true still returns a clear, honest 400 STREAMING_NOT_SUPPORTED, never faked.

known_limitations.label: SOURCE_ANALYSIS
items: Sampling is greedy-only (argmax) -- the existing decode loop (tools/membrane-llama-runtime/decode_loop.cpp's run_generation()) has no temperature/top_p support. Request fields are accepted and ignored, never faked; the response's own additive membrane.sampling field says so explicitly.

PR A2's own original 'ASan/UBSan clean' claim for test_registry_core was not actually testing anything -- membrane_registry_core linked no sanitizer flags at all (confirmed via `nm`: zero __asan_* symbols in the built binary even under -DMEMBRANE_ENABLE_SANITIZERS=ON). Fixed in PR A3 (retroactive correction, not carried forward silently) -- confirmed fixed via the same `nm` check, now showing real instrumentation.

PR A3's own original claim that 'CI's own existing thread-sanitizer job will cover' the new multi-threaded server code was also incorrect -- that job never sets MEMBRANE_ENABLE_LLAMA, so it built none of the new code. Fixed in PR A3 by adding a separate, target-scoped server-thread-sanitizer CI job (confirmed passing in CI on the merged PR).

A genuine shutdown deadlock was found and fixed during PR A3 development: httplib::Server::is_running() starts false until the listener thread's own listen_internal() actually begins running; without svr.wait_until_ready(), the main thread's poll loop could see is_running()==false on its very first check, exit immediately, make svr.stop() a silent no-op, and then block forever in listener.join() on a listener that, by then, had actually started serving. Confirmed directly with an instrumented build (SIGTERM delivered and handled, process never exited) before the fix.

A request-shape-validation-ordering bug was found and fixed during PR A3 development: malformed chat messages were validated AFTER the model-registry lookup, so a malformed message against an unregistered model name incorrectly returned 404 instead of 400. Reordered.

GPU-layers/KV-precision context-auto planning is fixed at first model load per docs/server.md's own disclosed limitation (see context_auto_in_server above) -- not re-planned per request against an already-loaded model.

no_oom_free_guarantee: Recommendation/planning remains 'estimated safe fit,' never a guaranteed-no-OOM promise -- same wording discipline as Phase 33/34/35's own context-recommendation core this server reuses unchanged.
